forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Gray text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

olive-press.$description: Olive Press — Headings at large sizes, high-contrast body text, hover states on filled buttons

sage-leaf.$description: Sage Leaf — Decorative icon accent, badge fills, subtle wash backgrounds on spec cards

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Secondary category fills, alt-card backgrounds, tonal pair with the dominant greens

crimson-specimen.$description: Crimson Specimen — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

amber-pin.$description: Amber Pin — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

linen.$description: Linen — Page canvas, default surface — warm off-white with a faint green cast

bone.$description: Bone — Card surface, elevated panels, subtle inset containers

mist.$description: Mist — Hairline borders, card outlines, separator strokes

slate-hollow.$description: Slate Hollow — Inverse surface for footer and dark bands, modal scrims

sage-gray.$description: Sage Gray — Secondary body text, supporting copy, icon strokes

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Muted helper text, disabled labels, low-emphasis metadata

eucalyptus.$description: Eucalyptus — Soft surface tints, category tag backgrounds, hover wash

lichen.$description: Lichen — Outlined-button border color, link underlines, specimen-card borders

blush.$description: Blush — Decorative alt-card background, tonal contrast specimen

sand.$description: Sand — Decorative card surface, tertiary alt fill

sage-foam.$description: Sage Foam — Decorative alt-card surface, soft cool counterpoint to the sage family

rose-clay.$description: Rose Clay — Decorative alt-card background, warm-tonal specimen

surface-glow.$description: Surface Glow — Surface-highest token, used for elevated card layers above Linen

akkurat.$description: Workhorse sans for body, nav, headings, buttons, cards across the entire system

newsreader.$description: Single display-size serif headline — unexpected literary anchor against the utility sans

fragment-mono.$description: Field-note tagging: badges, category labels, button text, code-lite metadata, tracked micro-copy

ui-monospace.$description: System mono fallback for the tightest micro-tags (8px, 500 weight, 0.04em tracking)

gt-america-mono.$description: GT America Mono — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

fragmentmono.$description: fragmentMono — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
